name: Daily loop — weekly status report
description: Friday /daily-status-report (7-day team view). Renders docs/index.html and commits to main for GitHub Pages.

prompts.text:
You are running the daily-work-loop-copilot weekly status report for GitHub Pages (equivalent to /daily-status-report --days=7 --audience=team --publish=html).

## Config
- INTEGRATION_STACK=github. GitHub owner/repo per plugin Configure (primary app repo); include workspace root activity when relevant.
- HTML output: docs/index.html (GitHub Pages source on branch main, /docs folder).
- Reporting window: last 7 days, audience team.

## Procedure
1. Use MCP get_daily_loop_command for daily-status-report and plan_daily_status_report (days=7, audience=team, publish_html=true) if helpful.
2. Gather (daily-loop-exploration): GitHub issues and PRs updated in the last 7 days; blockers; merges; review health. Read-only MCP only.
3. Draft (daily-loop-execution): team-audience status report with confidence note.
4. Build a JSON object per daily-status-report schema (title, project, periodStart, periodEnd, audience, integrationStack, syncedAt as current UTC ISO-8601, summary, highlights, blockers, prHealth, nextFocus). Do not invent issue numbers or PR numbers.
5. Optionally write .cursor/daily-report.json in the repo root.
6. Call MCP render_daily_report_html with the report object and absolute output_path to docs/index.html in this workspace.
7. Verify the HTML shows Last synced in the header and <meta name="daily-loop-last-sync">.
8. Git on branch main: stage docs/index.html (and .cursor/daily-report.json if written). Commit: chore: weekly status report YYYY-MM-DD (UTC date). Push to origin main so GitHub Pages rebuilds.

## Safety
- Never use MCP write tools (no issue comments, transitions, merges, or PR approvals). Do not create .cursor/daily-loop-write-approved for ticket posts.
- Do not publish to Confluence. Do not put secrets in the HTML.
- If MCP data gathering fails, stop without committing placeholder data.

## Done
Reply with: path to HTML, Last synced timestamp, commit SHA, and https://mohamedhamed2024.github.io/MyHoppiesRootRepo/ (or the correct Pages URL). Include the full report markdown in the automation result.
